original_answer.example_en: First thing in the morning, I check my messages.
original_answer.example_zh: 早上一起来，我首先查看消息。
collocations: call first thing in the morning
original_answer.usage_note: 指早晨很早或首先做某事，不必是字面上的第一件物品。

previous_author_answer.meaning_zh: 早上一起来就；早晨第一件事就
previous_author_answer.example_en: First thing in the morning, I check my messages.
previous_author_answer.example_zh: 早上一起来，我第一件事就是查看消息。
collocations: call first thing in the morning
previous_author_answer.usage_note: first thing in the morning是表示时间的状语性短语，常修饰call、check、leave等动作。

revised_answer.meaning_zh: 清晨一开始就；一大早首先
revised_answer.example_en: First thing in the morning, I check my messages.
revised_answer.example_zh: 早晨一开始，我就查看消息。
collocations: call first thing in the morning
revised_answer.usage_note: first thing in the morning通常指清晨一开始或一大早就做某事，不一定是醒来后立即做的第一件事；属时间状语性短语。

original_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
original_answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
original_answer.usage_note: take out表示从洗衣机中取出；此源项是待独立审核增补候选。

previous_author_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
previous_author_answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
previous_author_answer.usage_note: take the laundry out本身只指将衣物拿出来；具体是从洗衣机里取出，由当前洗涤程序的场景决定。

revised_answer.meaning_zh: 把衣物拿出来；（本场景）从洗衣机取出衣物
revised_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
revised_answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
revised_answer.usage_note: take the laundry out指把衣物拿出来，本身不要求衣物已经洗好；例句中as soon as the cycle finishes才表示程序结束后取出。
